_comment: Remote GPU build rows (carbon/reconstruction/remote_gpu_build.py): "<challenge> <version>": {"device_kind": <the GPU CLASS, the ONE rented variant exactly as nvidia-smi names it>, "slots": N per box (optional, default 1, at most 7 on a box: 7 x 4-core cpusets; a box set up before 17 Nov offers its 4), "memory": "shared" (no cap: each build holds what it uses) or "capped" (default; N > 1 waits on Validator-2)}. No row: the door's builds run where they run today. The door binds the CLASS, never a box. The boxes are the files scripts/dev/gpu_box_up.py door writes on PASS in <HOST_ROOT>/remote-gpu-build-boxes.d/<box>.json (0700 dir, 0600 files of the door user), read at every build: add a file = a box joins, remove it = the box drains (running builds finish), no restart. No box up = graphs build on the CPU. A local slot lane (this host's own GPU) still comes from remote-gpu-build-lanes.json with docker_host/stage_root null. The GPU class needs the owner's hardware acceptance in code. Motor 1.8 (Lead, 16 Nov, for Validator-2's read): the Lambda A100 40GB, 4 shared slots per box (bench: bit-identical at N=1/2/4/7, 2.2x throughput at 4); on-demand boxes (owner, 17 Nov): up to 3, rented and released with the queue. Owner, 17 Nov 2026 (OWNER_LINES C8: "More build spots per A100. I don't want to overpay."): 7 shared slots per box, the bench-proven N (commit 423c2bce: bit-identical at N=1/2/4/7, 2.5x throughput at 7, 524 MiB per build), 7 x 4 vCPUs of the box's 30. Lead pick (A), 20 Nov 2026 (door-code 12:31Z root cause: at 7 builds per box 51 pct of builds crossed the 600 s wall vs 5-8 pct at 1-3; V2 12:41:12Z content Y, applies only on the owner's line replacing C8 / G19): 4 shared slots per box, the same 4-core cpusets (the first 4 of BOX_SLOT_CPUSETS), the same shared GPU memory, the same wall; reversible; measured 24 h after. Applied at a door restart (the class is pinned at start) once no build holds a slot 4..6 (python -I -m carbon.reconstruction.remote_gpu_build held-from 4 <challenge> <version>). Cooling 1.8 (C5g, exam-cooling 20 Nov 2026, was TE3's 19 Nov plan; model-eval 19 Nov HYBRID RULING (2): GPU builds ON for official builds): chip-cold-plate 1.8 graph builds go to the SAME class and per-box shape as Motor 1.8 (the A100 40GB, 4 shared slots): no new class, so the owner's A100 acceptance (OWNER-A100-40GB-BUILD-CLASS-01, finney) and the A100 ops record serve it unchanged (both versions serve graph allowlist v8). On a host that runs both doors the boxes are one pool: each box file must list each door's JAX GPU worker image, and the 4 slots per box are shared by both doors' builds (a build that finds every slot busy waits for one).
